text: Attempt 7 begins: attempt 6's rules (loan rule, fire rules, shore pumps), same opening, then fill every pocket of the map with dense strips (stripplan.py) and add police coverage for land value.

Attempt 7 started. Attempt 6 reached 120,770 with no great fire and a balanced budget, but ran out of land. This time: use every pocket of the map, cross the river 5 years sooner, and add police for higher land value (taller buildings).

Feb 2002: loan #4 for the second coal plant + north job district (shops/factories at max demand).

Nov 2019: loan #16 (guard passed): first dense strip district on the south-west bank x6-40 y71-98 (stripplan.py), with fixes: cross streets joined over line y70, road rows re-laid over line crossings, line x36 joined around the lake, pipes joined.

CONTROL: stripplan.py's first district came out with roads cut by its own line columns and not joined to the main road, pipes not joined, and a line broken by the lake (26 audit FAILs, all fixed before running). Fixed the generator: lines are laid before roads, cross streets and their pipes reach up to join the road and pipe above.

CONTROL: two strip districts ran out of cash part-way (roads built, zones/pipes/lines missing) and needed extra loans and fix plans. Fixed: build.py now refuses a plan whose missing tiles cost more than the cash on hand (--cash-ok overrides).
Dec 2023: loans #19-20 finished the lower south-west strips (zones, pipes), shore pumps x70 and x51; line y117 joins line x44 and the pumps to the grid.

CONTROL: near the west edge and the north-east corner the view did not scroll to the plan, so two coal-plant builds (2025) became trails of stray road tiles and cost ~$5,000. Fixed: build.py refuses plans within 8 tiles of the west edge or the north corners (--west-ok); the harmless strays are listed in run.json known_strays (audit WARN, not FAIL).
